coastal.title: Sooke's infrastructure to play key role in municipal election
coastal.description: In the District of Sooke on Vancouver Island, the population has been growing steadily since the early 2000s — and local infrastructure has been struggling to keep pace due to environmental regulations, and a growing strain on limited resources.

coastal.title: B.C. teen rescued from 'Widowmaker' mountain trail says AI isn't to blame
coastal.description: Bryce Gowryluk, 16, was lifted from Crown Mountain by helicopter Saturday after accidentally taking what's called the "Widowmaker" climbing route.

kamloops.title: Okanagan growers say crop insurance isn’t keeping up with a changing climate
kamloops.description: The weather can bring extreme heat, cold, drought, hail or wildfire smoke, and any one of those can wipe out a crop or make grapes impossible to sell.

kamloops.title: Transformative former B.C. attorney general Colin Gablemann dead at 82
kamloops.description: Colin Gablemann, the transformative former British Columbia attorney general who played a key role in the creation of the province's freedom of information laws and recognizing Indigenous rights has died at the age of 82.

kamloops.title: Author tells B.C. defamation trial sexual assault claim derailed career, ability to write
kamloops.description: Author and former UBC creative writing professor Steven Galloway wept as he testified that he can no longer write since unproven allegations of sexual assault derailed his career.

cariboo.title: Massive gold mine casts shadow over municipal election in small Cariboo town
cariboo.description: Two candidates are campaigning for mayor, as approval of the Cariboo Gold Project has created disruption in the Gold-Rush-era town of Wells, B.C. — known for its vibrant artistic community and the gateway for Barkerville Historic Park and the Bowron Lakes.

all.title: Climate-driven wildfires in Canada could cost future generations trillions: study
all.description: "A motivation of this study was to put it into economic terms that the general public could grasp a little bit better," researcher Sian Kou-Giesbrecht said.
